title: For patient born between 1936-1956, how many male patients have creatinine
question:
For patient born between 1936-1956, how many male patients have creatinine phosphokinase beyond the normal range?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: born between 1936-1956 refers to year(Birthday) BETWEEN '1936' AND '1956'; male patients refers to sex = 'M'; creatinine phosphokinase beyond the normal range refers to CPK > = 250; Should consider DISTINCT in the final result;

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON p.XCL_058 = l.XCL_014
WHERE p.XCL_060 BETWEEN '1936-01-01' AND '1956-12-31'
  AND p.XCL_063 = 'M'
  AND l.XCL_020 > l.XCL_021

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.XCL_058)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.XCL_058 = T2.XCL_014
WHERE substr(T1.XCL_060,1,4) BETWEEN '1936' AND '1956'
  AND T1.XCL_059 = 'M'
  AND T2.XCL_028 >= 250;
